svg.aria-label: One annotated element, the flower head, becomes training queries. On the photo, the blue box is the annotated tight box; the solid red window is an enlarged query window with the flower in its lower right corner; the dashed red window has the same size and was moved to the left, clear of the hatched related boxes (the flower head and the whole rose). To the right are the four description forms with their sampling shares. Below are the two queries, which share the description deep red bloom.
svg.text: the deep red bloom of the rose, with
same as full here: the description is one sentence
